subject: Post-demo: proposed trial milestones & risk checklist — Lumenia Health
messages:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Grant <alex.grant@lumeniahealth.com>, Maya Ortiz <maya.ortiz@lumeniahealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-04-11T15:02:00-07:00
Subject: Post-demo: proposed trial milestones & risk checklist — Lumenia Health

Thanks again for your time today — really appreciated the openness on integration constraints and the clinical validation needs. Per our demo, I captured a compact trial proposal and the key risks we should surface up front. Please review and confirm whether this aligns with Lumenia's priorities.

Quick summary / proposed POC (high level)
- Objective: Validate Redwood inference for clinical note summarization at scale with acceptable latency and precision for triage workflows.
- Success criteria (pass/fail):
  1) Latency: 95th percentile generation < 450ms for 256-token outputs on dedicated instance during business hours.
  2) Precision/Recall proxy: extractive overlap score >= 0.78 on the provided 200-case evaluation set.
  3) Throughput: handle 120 concurrent requests with <10% degradation over baseline.
- Timeline: 2-week kickoff + 4-week evaluation (total 6 weeks). Kickoff tasks in week 0: dataset ingestion (S3), brief security review, and baseline runs.
- Ownership: Redwood: model config + infra; Lumenia: test dataset, acceptance label set, PO/contract sign-off.

Risk checklist (things we should approve before kickoff)
- Data transfer: confirm S3 bucket permissions and retention windows.
- Security: SOC2 + optional VPC peering if required.
- Model variant: recommend starting with m-instruct-13B-quant (cost-performance balance) and option to swap to m-instruct-30B if quality gaps appear.

Next steps / asks
1) Can Lumenia confirm success criteria above by EOD Friday?
2) Share a 200-case sample (anonymized) plus one user acceptance contact for acceptance testing.
3) If PO will be required prior to kickoff, please send the template — we can fast-track review.

Attachments: POC_Scope_v1.pdf (7 pages), MUTUAL_ACTION_PLAN.xlsx (template)

Thanks — I can be flexible on the timeline if you need additional security gating.

Best,
Hannah Schmitt
Senior Enterprise Solutions Manager
Redwood Inference
hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0124
From: Alex Grant <alex.grant@lumeniahealth.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
Cc: Maya Ortiz <maya.ortiz@lumeniahealth.com>
Date: 2027-04-11T17:19:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo: proposed trial milestones & risk checklist — Lumenia Health

Hannah — thanks for the clear write-up and for the demo. A couple quick clarifications from our side: 

- Data: we can provide a 200-case sample but it will need to be pushed to a temporary S3 bucket with 30-day retention. Is that acceptable for Redwood operations?
- Model variant: clinical team is cautious about hallucinations. Would switching to the larger 30B variant for the evaluation make sense as a default, or should we start smaller and escalate? It sounds like cost will be a factor.
- PO: we will likely need a PO before ramp. I attached our procurement intake question list in the reply (see attachment: Lumenia_PO_Questions.pdf).

Also — can you confirm whether Redwood can meet the latency target at 95th percentile under realistic traffic? Our engineers will want a short benchmark run during kickoff.

Appreciate the responsiveness — aim to confirm the success criteria by Fri.

— Alex
Director, Clinical AI
Lumenia Health
alex.grant@lumeniahealth.com | +1 212-555-0442
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Grant <alex.grant@lumeniahealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-04-12T09:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo: proposed trial milestones & risk checklist — Lumenia Health

Alex — quick answers inline: 

- S3 retention: 30-day retention on a customer-owned bucket is fine. We request read-only IAM role access scoped to the dataset path; we will provide a short setup doc.
- Model variant: recommended approach — start with m-instruct-13B-quant for a two-week baseline run (cost-effective) and if extractive/summary quality falls <0.75 we swap to m-instruct-30B for the final two-week evaluation. That lets us compare cost vs. quality. If Lumenia prefers to start on 30B, we can propose a short budget estimate — happy to loop in finance.
- Latency: we will run a 30-minute benchmark during kickoff with your sample traffic profile. Historically Redwood hits <450ms p95 on a dedicated mk8 instance for 256-token outputs for similar workloads; we'll include the exact config in the kickoff playbook.

I attached a brief Data Handling FAQ to cover retention, redaction, and logs (data_handling_faq.pdf).

Suggested immediate next steps:
1) Lumenia to confirm success criteria + provide sample dataset by Thu 4/15 EOD.
2) Redwood will prepare kickoff playbook and benchmark script by Mon 4/18.
3) Mutual action plan (attached) — please mark owners & target dates.

If the procurement team needs a direct contact at Redwood for PO review, Ben is looping on this thread and will take point.

Hannah

Attachment: data_handling_faq.pdf (3 pages)
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-04-12T11:07:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Post-demo: proposed trial milestones & risk checklist — internal notes

Looping internal notes here so we have a clean handoff. Ben — can you confirm willingness to be primary CS lead for Lumenia and estimate 8 hours/week for the 6-week engagement (kickoff + evaluation)? Also, procurement will almost certainly push for a 30B-first ask if clinical insists. Recommend we prepare a one-off price delta (13B -> 30B) and a short justification doc.

- Procurement lead: Maya Ortiz

Marissa

Hannah / Marissa — all good from our side. We confirm the success criteria with a minor tweak: prefer the extractive overlap score target to be >= 0.80 (clinical team request). We will provide the anonymized 200-case sample to the S3 path by Thu 4/15 and our PO template (attached).

Please proceed with the kickoff playbook and benchmark script. Ben — feel free to reach out to me directly to coordinate procurement questions.

Forwarded attachment: Lumenia_PO_Template.pdf (procurement fields filled)

Thanks — excited to get started.

— Alex
